'''Corla Metonae''' was the [[Chief Petty Officer/Legends|Chief Petty Officer]] on the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']]. In service to the [[House of Organa/Legends|royal house]] of her [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Metonae, a member of the [[House of Antilles]], served aboard the ''Tantive IV'' under her uncle, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], during the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. In her original role as [[Bosun/Legends|bosun]] and [[Petty Officer/Legends|petty officer]], she was placed in charge of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette's]] [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]].

During a routine test of the pods, the ''Tantive IV'' came [[Battle of the Karthakk System|under attack]] from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from the [[Karthakk system]]. As a result, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was forced to flee and abandon its launched pods, one of which contained the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. Following the incident, Metonae was reassigned to [[Project Another Chance|Project: Another Chance]], which concerned Alderaan's disarmament following the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Despite interference from the Empire, the project was a success, and Metonae was reassigned back to the ''Tantive IV''. She [[Death/Legends|perished]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] when the craft was [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|boarded]] and destroyed by the forces of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].

==Biography==
===Early service===
Corla Metonae, a member of the [[House of Antilles]], was raised on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She served aboard the [[consular ship]] [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] under the command of her uncle, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]]. Metonae took on the role of [[Bosun/Legends|bosun]] and [[Petty Officer/Legends|petty officer]], which placed her in charge of the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] deck crew and craft, such as the [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]] and the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], she oversaw a test launch of the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} pods.<ref name="db" />

While the pods were jettisoned, the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was [[Battle of the Karthakk System|attacked]] by<ref name="db" /> the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]],<ref name="Droids Re-Animated">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-1|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] from the [[Karthakk system]], forcing the ''Tantive IV'' to depart the area hurriedly. Following the retreat, the ship's crew discovered that two of the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], had been aboard the launched pods and were now stranded. Metonae was held responsible for the loss of the valuable automatons, and she was reassigned to [[Project Another Chance|Project: Another Chance]]. Meanwhile, [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] made the recovery of the droids a top priority for the crew of the ''Tantive IV''.<ref name="db" />

===Project: Another Chance===
[[File:Another_Chance.jpg|thumb|left|170px|The ''Another Chance''.]]
Metonae's reassignment, contrary to appearances, was not disciplinary. Her organizational skills were needed by Project: Another Chance, a flagship initiative to disarm Alderaan following the [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] and chaotic [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The disarmament was voluntary, not enforced by the Empire at all, and Metonae was given a leadership role in organizing the project. A single [[Alderaanian War Frigate|war frigate]], the ''[[Another Chance]]'', was converted into an automated [[armory ship]], in which all of Alderaan's weaponry would be stored indefinitely. The craft, escorted by three [[Thranta-class War Cruiser|automated escort ships]], would make perpetual [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jumps until recalled home by the Alderaanian [[Council of Elders (Alderaan)|Council of Elders]].<ref name="db" />

She directly oversaw the launch of the ''Another Chance'' and its three escorts, although covert agents from the Galactic Empire attempted to sabotage the operation. An Imperial taskforce intended to intercept and take the ''Another Chance'', with its contents, and put them to use in the service of the Empire, forcing Metonae to act quickly. She deployed a set of decoy craft carrying [[transponder]] signals that matched those of the ''Another Chance'' and its escort, which lured the Imperials away from their true targets.<ref name="db" />

===Return to the ''Tantive IV''===
Suitably impressed with Project: Another Chance, Organa reassigned Metonae back to the ''Tantive IV'', where she was given the rank of [[Master chief petty officer|Master Chief Petty Officer]]. The droids R2-D2 and C-3PO had been recovered by Antilles and given instructions to never enter an escape pod again.<ref name="db" /> Metonae oversaw the expansive [[Vanguard c20 retrofit suite|Vanguard c20]] refit of the corvette [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], which upgraded the ship's weapons, [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and sensor capacity, effectively making it a [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]].<ref name="rr">{{InsiderCite|90|Refresher Reading}}</ref>

[[File:Devastatortantiveiv.png|thumb|180px|The ''Tantive IV'' being pursued by the ''Devastator''.]]
Metonae and the crew of the ''Tantive IV'' would continue to serve Organa and his daughter, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], over the years.<ref name="db" /> In the service of the princess, the ''Tantive IV'' began to do work for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], a rebellion movement against [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the ship traveled to [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]], where it [[Battle of Toprawa|retrieved]] [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the Empire's new [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]], the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].<ref name="raf">''[[The Rise and Fall of Darth Vader]]''</ref>

The ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} actions attracted the attention of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], a powerful Imperial warrior who had been monitoring the Princess's actions. At Toprawa, while receiving the plans, the ''Tantive IV'' was hailed by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Nahdonnis Praji]] of the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']], Vader's ship, and ordered to heave to. Captain Antilles refused to comply, resulting in a chase that took the consular ship to the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. There, the Princess hoped to give the plans to the former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. However, the ''Devastator'' [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|captured and boarded]] the ''Tantive IV''. Vader, in a mad hunt for the plans, had the ship destroyed.<ref name="raf" /> Metonae, who was still on board, perished during the ''Tantive IV''{{'s}} destruction.<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
Corla Metonae was a talented organizer, picked to oversee projects such as the ''Another Chance'' initiative and the refit of the ''Sundered Heart''. Though she was held responsible for the loss of R2-D2 and C-3PO, she was not truly disciplined, and was instead given control over a far more major enterprise than that of a single consular ship. She was able to avert disaster, and thwarted Imperial agents attempting to hamstring Project: Another Chance by commissioning decoys.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|And, of course, Randy Stradley knows where he can find me for an eventual Rogue Leader-esque miniseries to bookend that Droids Omnibus collection that's sure to come out in a few years.|[[Billy Buehler]]|<ref name="blog">{{Blog|literature|2|What's the Story?: Behind the scenes of Corla Metonae}}</ref>}}
Corla Metonae was originally known as the "Alderaanian Bosun,"<ref name="wts">"[[What's The Story?]]" original submission sheet</ref> and was a character created for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']], although she does not appear in the final cut of the film. The character was given a name and a backstory by [[Billy Buehler]], writing as "The2ndQuest," through the [[StarWars.com]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] feature, "[[What's The Story?]]."

The entry built upon a brief explanation made by [[Ryder Windham]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' relevant to the adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO prior to the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. At the end of ''Revenge of the Sith'', the droids are shown to be serving aboard the ''Tantive IV'', in the service of Captain Raymus Antilles, and at the start of ''A New Hope'', they are in the same situation. This clashes with the [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] television series, the accompanying [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|comic series]] from [[Star Comics]] and the [[Dark Horse Comics]] [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|series of the same name]], which all featured the pair of droids in miscellaneous adventures prior to ''A New Hope'' but after ''Revenge of the Sith''.

Windham's book had mentioned that the droids had been lost by the Alderaanians due to a mistake, and so Buehler chose to elaborate on that by making Metonae the guilty party, thereby helping to resolve the discrepancy. In addition to that, Buehler connected Metonae's story to that of the ''Another Chance'', which initially featured in the [[West End Games]] adventure supplement, ''[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]'', published in [[1991]]. One connection, to "[[Master Devwi]]'s" [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry on the [[XJ-2 airspeeder/Legends|XJ-2 airspeeder]] concerning Bail Organa's alias of "Org Banelli," was cut in the editorial process. Further references were made to the [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']] series.<ref name="blog" /> The character was later mentioned in the article ''[[Refresher Reading]]'', published in [[Star Wars Insider 90|''Star Wars Insider'' 90]].
